title: Plugin to enable creating arbitrary trigger zones

posts.author: Antidote174
ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Welcome!
Thanks for sharing your work. Just a couple of thoughts for posterity:
- This is commonly referred to in RPG Maker as modifying the event's hitbox.
- It seems best practice would be to leave the triggered portion in the event like always - if it should only happen once, the user has event commands to activate a second blank page with a self switch or uses Erase Event or some such. Adding your own property to the event which isn't accessible via the editor could create confusion and unexpected behavior.
- To keep things standardized with other plugins people would use, you can enclose your information in <angled brackets> and retrieve it with the event's meta property, rather than requiring the user to learn and use JSON syntax.
Thanks for the contribution.

I think you're misunderstanding the purpose of the
triggerOnce
value, it's not for saving the state, it's there as a temporary, you can and should still use things like self switches, Erase Event, Exit Event Processing, and blank pages as per normal. The point of
triggerOnce
is to ensure it only happens once per map session, but if you think it should be, I can remove that behavior, it would simplify the plugin a little bit. However I was looking into implementing a way to reset that via event commands, and if I were to require erasing the event to prevent multiple triggers I couldn't implement that.
